content: Truth is the summit of being; justice is the application of it to affairs.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Truth is not a mere intellectual puzzle; its living purpose is the practical enactment of fair, compassionate justice in human relationships and society.
practicalInsight: Ensure that all your business and personal transactions today are grounded in transparent fairness.
reflectionPrompt: In what practical interaction can you apply higher standards of justice and fairness?
